entries.9a6cc6942f38c66e: The core business of the group, which consists of the company and one non-consolidated subsidiary, is a single segment of general retail business whose main business is home centers. It operates home centers in the Chugoku and Kinki regions, and as of February 28, 2026, it had 116 stores. It is working to strengthen its product offering, centered on the agriculture and gardening and construction and DIY departments.
